meals.name: Crispy Chicken Tacos with Creamy Cilantro Lime Slaw
meals.description: Flavorful chicken pieces coated in spicy breading, fried until crispy, served in soft tortillas with a zesty slaw. Cook time is approximately 40 minutes.

ingredients.name: Dixie Diners' Club hot & spicy chicken breading

instructions: Cut chicken breasts into 1/2-inch strips. Place chicken breading in a shallow dish.
Heat vegetable oil in a large deep skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat to 350°F (175°C). Dredge chicken strips in breading, ensuring even coating.

Carefully fry chicken in batches for 4-6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature 165°F / 74°C). Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a wire rack set over paper towels to drain. Season lightly with salt if desired.
For the slaw, combine shredded cabbage, juice of 1 lime, chopped cilantro, sour cream, mayonnaise, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and hot sauce (if using) in a medium bowl. Mix well.
Warm tortillas according to package directions. Fill each tortilla with crispy chicken and a generous spoonful of cilantro lime slaw. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Cheesy Beef Quesadillas with Quick Guacamole
meals.description: Savory ground beef seasoned with taco spices, melted with cheese between tortillas, served with fresh guacamole. Total time is under 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: shredded cheddar or Mexican blend cheese

instructions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown ground beef with chopped onion until no pink remains. Drain any excess fat.

Add minced garlic and taco seasoning mix to the beef, stir for 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in 1/2 cup water and bring to a simmer, cooking until most of the liquid has absorbed, about 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
For guacamole, mash avocados in a small bowl. Stir in lime juice and salt to taste.

To assemble quesadillas, heat a clean skillet or griddle over medium heat. Place one tortilla in the pan, sprinkle half with cheese, then spoon beef mixture over the cheese. Top with more cheese and cover with the other half of the tortilla, or place a second tortilla on top. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown and cheese is melted. Repeat with remaining ingredients.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and serve immediately with quick guacamole and optional sour cream or salsa.

meals.name: Slow Cooker Pork Carnitas Bowls with Rice and Black Beans
meals.description: Tender, succulent pork shoulder slow-cooked until shreddable, then crisped in the oven, served over rice with seasoned black beans. This is a slow cooker meal with minimal active prep.
instructions: Cut pork shoulder into 2-inch chunks. Place pork in a slow cooker. Squeeze juice from orange and lime halves over the pork, then add the fruit halves to the pot.

Add minced garlic, cumin, dried oregano, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper to the slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or on high for 3-4 hours, until pork is very tender and easily shreddable.
Carefully remove pork from the slow cooker and shred with two forks. Place shredded pork on a baking sheet. Discard citrus rinds.
Preheat oven broiler. Drizzle 1/4 cup of the slow cooker liquid over the shredded pork. Broil for 5-10 minutes, stirring once, until the pork edges are crispy and browned.

While pork broils, cook jasmine rice according to package directions. Gently warm black beans in a small saucepan with a splash of water and a pinch of salt. To serve, build bowls with jasmine rice, seasoned black beans, crispy carnitas, and garnish with fresh cilantro and diced red onion.

meals.name: Spicy Beef and Broccoli Stir-fry with Jasmine Rice
meals.description: Quick and flavorful beef and broccoli stir-fry with a zesty, spicy Asian sauce, served over fluffy jasmine rice. Cook time is around 35 minutes.

ingredients.name: flank steak or sirloin
ingredients.amount: 1 lb, thinly sliced against the grain

instructions: Cook jasmine rice according to package directions. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, oyster sauce, hot sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, corn starch, and 2 tablespoons of water to create the stir-fry sauce. Set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Add sliced beef and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until browned. Remove beef from skillet and set aside.

Add remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet. Add broccoli florets and red bell pepper, stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender. Add minced garlic and grated ginger, stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.

Return beef to the skillet. Give the stir-fry sauce a quick whisk and pour it over the beef and vegetables. Cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens and coats the ingredients, about 1-2 minutes.
Remove from heat and serve immediately over the prepared jasmine rice. Garnish with sesame seeds if desired.

meals.name: Sheet Pan Lemon Herb Cod with Roasted Asparagus and Cherry Tomatoes
meals.description: Flaky cod fillets roasted with vibrant asparagus and sweet cherry tomatoes, all seasoned with bright lemon and herbs. This easy meal cooks in about 30 minutes on one pan.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large sheet pan with parchment paper.

On the sheet pan, toss asparagus and cherry tomatoes with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, lemon pepper seasoning, dried dill, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Spread into a single layer and roast for 10 minutes.
While vegetables roast, pat cod fillets dry. Drizzle cod with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, sprinkle with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
After 10 minutes, remove the sheet pan from the oven. Push vegetables to one side and place cod fillets on the other side. Arrange lemon slices over the cod.
Return to the oven and roast for another 10-15 minutes, or until the cod flakes easily with a fork and the vegetables are tender-crisp. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Hearty Italian Sausage and Vegetable Bake with Creamy Polenta
meals.description: Flavorful Italian sausage baked with an assortment of vegetables in a rich tomato sauce, served alongside smooth, creamy polenta. Cook time is about 75 minutes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). In a large oven-safe skillet or 9x13 inch baking dish, combine bell peppers, zucchini, chopped onion, and minced garlic.
Crumble Italian sausage over the vegetables. Pour Classico pasta sauce and beef broth over the mixture. Stir in dried oregano and crushed red pepper (if using).
Bake for 45-50 minutes, stirring halfway through, until sausage is cooked through (internal temperature 160°F / 71°C) and vegetables are tender. Stir in grated Parmesan cheese.

While the bake finishes, prepare the creamy polenta: Bring 4 cups of water and 1 cup of milk to a boil in a medium saucepan. Whisk in dry polenta slowly, reduce heat to low, and continue whisking occasionally for 5-7 minutes, until thick and creamy.
Remove polenta from heat, stir in butter, salt, and pepper to taste. If polenta is too thick, add a splash more milk or water.
Serve the Italian sausage and vegetable bake hot, spooned over creamy polenta.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Mushroom Noodle Casserole
meals.description: A comforting baked casserole featuring tender chicken, mushrooms, and egg noodles in a rich, creamy sauce. Cook time is about 60 minutes.

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.amount: 1.5 lbs, cooked and shredded or diced

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Cook egg noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain well.

While noodles cook, melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add sliced mushrooms and chopped onion, cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
In a large bowl, combine cooked and shredded chicken, cooked noodles, mushroom-onion mixture, cream of mushroom soup, chicken broth, milk, sour cream, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a small bowl, toss panko bread crumbs with 1 tablespoon melted butter. Sprinkle evenly over the casserole.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until bubbling around the edges and the topping is golden brown. Garnish with fresh parsley if desired, and serve hot.
